faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Scottish Fold?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 6-13 lb (2.7-6 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a kitten Scottish Fold?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Osteochondrodysplasia (fold ear cartilage disease); Arthritis secondary to cartilage dysplasia; Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) risk. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.answer: Every 1-2 weeks on the same scale while a Scottish Fold is growing, with the number saved beside vaccine dates.
